decisionCategories.pattern: Keep pinned brownfield knowledge in conformance artifacts; production gains only target-neutral construct support.
Use opaque graph IDs plus developer-only source provenance to correlate lightweight probes without leaking Java details.
Resolve graph semantics once and keep text formats as deterministic dependency-free projections.
Preserve result-relevant optionality as absent/exists while stripping language- and persistence-specific vocabulary from business projections.
Let the build tool provide source roots, resolved classpaths, and explicit repository settings, while the engine owns graph and provenance contracts.
Keep source data outside business records and verify both working files and exact commit blobs before a developer export claims a Git revision.
